subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Identifies boxes among 3-D objects and describes their properties

show.line: This is a box. It has flat sides and corners. You can stack boxes on top of each other!

rounds.prompt: What is this? Say it with me. Box!
Count the flat sides you can see on this box.
rounds.praise: Three flat sides! A box has more at the back.

rounds.prompt: Which one is shaped like a box?
rounds.praise: Yes! A cereal box is a box.

rounds.prompt: Box or not a box? Put each thing in its group.
Which pile can you stack safely? Boxes stack. Balls roll off.

hints: A box has flat sides and pointy corners.
Can it stack? Boxes stack. Balls roll.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a box.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This tin! It is a box.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! A tin is round and rolls. A box has flat sides.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's feel together. Flat sides and corners. That is a box!

parent_line: Can recognise a box and say that it has flat sides.
